body.x: Tineco unveiled its home appliances in its booth at CES 2023. Its lineup had Smart kitchen solutions consisting of its Smart cooker Chiere One and Smart toaster Toasty One.

Chiere One guides each cooking step with video and audio displayed on a 7" touch screen. It contains Intelligent Heating System, Feeding System, Weighing System, and One-Touch Self-Cleaning mode to offer a hassle-free cooking experience. At Tineco's booth, chefs cooked various meals - including ones created from prepared meal kits exclusive under the Tineco brand.

body.cap: A chef cooking pasta with Chiere One at the booth | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Tineco said that Chiere One's app control allows users to access, save, and share numerous recipes. It continued that Chiere One adjusts heat temperature and heating time with three-dimensional heating that heats the inner pot evenly - differing from conventional plate heating that only heats the chassis. It also stated that Chiere One has features assisting cooks - a voice prompt that directs users to put ingredients following a recipe, an integrated scale that gauges contents in the cooker in real-time, and a feeding system that automatically stirs and seasons food ingredients while cooking.

body.cap: Tineco's Chiere One | Photo by AVING News
Tineco's Toasty One | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Toasty One, Tineco's newest food-tech product, is a dual-slot toaster designed with Smart capabilities to deliver a perfect slice of toast with every use. Tineco stated that this toaster intends to offer a personalized toasting experience, with its dual slot able to toast each slice of bread differently on each side of the toaster. For added convenience, the toaster also saves up to eight preset toasting preferences and has a removable tray that simplifies the cleanup. Visitors at Tineco's booth tried Toasty One by making their customized toast - with spreads including jams and butter provided on the side.

body.cap: Tineco's Toasty One | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Tineco further highlighted the unique Smart features of the toaster. 4-inch LCD Touchscreen visualizes the toasting process that users slide and pick one of four functions available - Smart, fresh, reheat, or frozen - as well as their preferred toasting level from a toasting level slider. IntelliHeat Technology identifies the bread condition with sensors, automatically adjusts the heat output, then toasts to the desired level. GoldenCrispy Technology seals in the moistness of a toast by forging a crisp exterior with a delicate and tasty interior.
